text_block_list.text:
With a fantastic performance in the<n>Twinkle Series,
Grass Wonder has<n>had an impressive first three
years.

A large milestone is now behind us.<n>But one
peaceful day...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Well then, everyone...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now that things have settled down,<n>would all of you
like to join me on a<n>hike in the mountains?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Qué?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Say what?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: As in mountain mountains?

I thought it might be nice for us all to<n>have a trip
together before El goes<n>overseas.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, this is new, Grass being all
spur-of-the-moment.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It sounds like it'll be a lotta fun!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And you're doin' it all for me? I'm so<n>so so so
touched! So grateful! So—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: It's just a little idea for everyone tomake some lovely memories, that'sall.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ouch! Reeejected!
choice_data_list: Are you sure you want me along?
Are you sure you want me along?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But of course. Your presence is an<n>absolute must,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I can hardly wait. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we head for the base<n>of the
mountain?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It's been ages since I saw<n>Grass smile like
this.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Grrr... It irks me knowin' it's cuz<n>she's been
winnin' like mad!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Though... it's true that a sunny<n>sonrisa is what
suits Grass best.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But that said, I am SO wipin' that<n>smirk off her face
eventually!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, will you, El?

C... c'mon everybody! We're gonna<n>lose all the
daylight draggin' our feet<n>like this! Let's run to the
mountain!
Sounds like a race. I'm in.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Last one there's gotta carry all our<n>bags!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The stakes have skyrocketed! That's<n>a little scary,
Sei!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Get back hereeee!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wha—?! E-everybody?!
Hmph! All right then!
I won't lose, do you hear me?!
Oh my... Everyone is just so<n>competitive.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer? Your thoughts are written all<n>over your
face.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Dear me... Hehehe.
choice_data_list: Aren't you going to chase after them?
Aren't you going to chase after them?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Not today, no.
Today... I want to savor each step<n>along the way.

Grass Wonder and I leisurely take in<n>the sights
along the green trail<n>upward.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Each foot we lay upon the earth<n>brings us another
step forward.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: There is no path before me, only in<n>my wake.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The first time I stepped onto the<n>racetrack, I knew it
was where I<n>should be.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I decided that if I were to press<n>forward, I could not
allow myself to<n>stop until I reached the very top.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: At first, I believed it would be<n>straightforward.
choice_data_list:
But then you ran into twists and turns along the
way.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes... You're exactly right.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I was stumbling through my<n>immaturity, caught up
by trivialities. I<n>even got told off by my own friend.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: With how slow my progress felt,there were some nights I wonderedwhether I even could reach the top.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: But not any longer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I have Maruzen and Sei. Suzuka, El,<n>and Spe, too...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm surrounded by so many friends<n>and
supporters... And most of all,<n>Trainer, I have you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
This is the path I was meant to tread,<n>because I'm
the only one who can.

A path extending far into the distance,<n>to a
destination only I can reach.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
So... I will keep my head held high and<n>take each
step with purpose.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: To reach the top!
